findings.citation: spec.md, Backend: the Agent reaches an invoice by its id: "| `POST …/files` (new) | yes | yes, open to its Agent only (409 otherwise) | 403 |" and "One predicate in `ClientInvoiceService`, **open to its Agent**, ... gates every Agent write by id"
findings.note: attachFile calls requireOpenToAgent whatever the caller's role, so a Manager attaching a file by id to a past-month never-sent draft gets 409 PAST_MONTH_DRAFT_NOT_SENDABLE; the table gives the Manager an unconditional yes. Apply the check only for an Agent caller, with a test.

findings.citation: docs/agents/coding-standards.md: Frontend 8 — "Compose Tailwind classes from the tokens in `frontend/app/globals.css` (`@theme`, Tailwind v4); an arbitrary value (`w-[123px]`) needs a comment saying why it isn't a token. The two small type sizes are tokens, not arbitrary values, once the `type-scale-tokens` enabler lands"
findings.note: Changed lines use text-[12px]/text-[13px] and max-w-[260px]/min-w-[220px] with no comment: agent-client-invoice-card.tsx (121,129,143,153,159,169,185,200,229,231,273,278,290,294), client-invoices-view.tsx:131, client-invoice-detail-view.tsx:59, send-client-invoice-control.tsx:44, contract-switcher.tsx:65. Use text-label-sm/text-label; comment or tokenise the widths.

findings.citation: docs/agents/coding-standards.md: Frontend 1 — "Default every component to a Server Component; add \"use client\" only when the file needs state, effects, or browser APIs — not to \"be safe\"."
findings.note: New file declares "use client" with no state, effects or browser APIs; it only renders client controls.

findings.citation: docs/agents/coding-standards.md: Backend 3 — "The transaction boundary is the service method (`@Transactional`), never the repository or the controller"
findings.note: attachFile (status check + requireOpenToAgent + save) has no @Transactional, unlike send, editLine, sendBack, approve, which are @Transactional and take findByIdForUpdate.
After a successful send-back the control unmounts and focus falls to BODY; nothing announces the change. Move focus to the status note (tabIndex=-1) or announce it in an aria-live polite region.

findings.citation: web-design-guidelines: "Submit button stays enabled until request starts; spinner during request"
findings.note: While in flight Confirm send back only fades to 50%; no spinner or 'Sending back…' label. Show progress while keeping it focusable.

findings.citation: DESIGN.md: "**Don't** introduce a border color outside the `hairline`/`hairline-strong` tokens."
findings.note: SentBackNotice uses border-warning/40. Use border-hairline or no border.

findings.citation: WCAG 2.1 SC 2.4.3 Focus Order (Level A): If a Web page can be navigated sequentially and the navigation sequences affect meaning or operation, focusable components receive focus in an order that preserves meaning and operability.
findings.note: On the new by-id page (story 35), focus falls to BODY when the confirm opens, on Back, while sending (native disabled) and after success; Escape doesn't close the confirm. Focus Confirm on open, refocus the trigger on Back, use the aria-disabled+aria-busy busy mode, close on Escape, focus a status line after success.

On the by-id page a past-month non-draft invoice links Download PDF to the contract's current-month PDF route, so the Agent downloads another month's invoice; hide the link when billingMonth isn't the current month. Also a sent-back past-month draft reads 'this month's Fees — still being assembled'.
requireNonEmpty runs in the controller and again inside attachFile.
Summary, Fee-lines and Carrier-files sections closely repeat frontend/components/manager/client-invoice-detail-view.tsx.
Two new lines (lines 52 and 65) lean toward describing behaviour rather than pointing to role.
Controller goes straight to the repository and maps rows, no service (weak; package precedent).
requireOpenToAgent checks DRAFT, then isOpenToAgent checks it again.

The width fix's w-full makes the switcher span 992px at 1280px on the Agent Client Invoices and Fleet pages (it used to fit its label). Drop w-full, keep max-w-full plus truncation, or self-start on the root.
'Sent back to you' table: a long client name squeezes the Reason column to two words; Open clipped at 1280px; at 375px only Contract shows. Give the reason a min width and let Contract wrap/truncate.
The by-id page never names the Contract or Client; show client and country in the title or breadcrumb as the Manager's page does.
Approve stays enabled beside the open send-back form and the action row reflows awkwardly. Hide Approve while the form is open and render the form as its own full-width row.
Not-found copy says 'It may have been removed' (invoices are never removed) and the state has no breadcrumb. Use 'It doesn't exist or isn't one of yours.' plus the breadcrumb.
Dark-theme danger button: white on #f16b7a is ~2.95:1, below AA; pre-existing and app-wide. Give danger a passing dark-theme pairing.
Re-implements the focus-on-status-change logic of the new ClientInvoiceStatusNote; render it instead.
backendFetchList('/api/contracts') turns a failure into [] with no log, so the title silently falls back to 'Client Invoice'; use backendFetchJsonOrNull.
